contribution_method.description: EPF uses wage range tables for wages up to RM20,000. For wages above RM20,000, direct percentage applies. Total contribution rounded up to next ringgit.

malaysian_pr_nonmy_before_aug98_below_60.label: Malaysian / PR / Non-MY registered before 1 Aug 1998 (Below 60)

pr_nonmy_before_aug98_60_plus.label: PR / Non-MY registered before 1 Aug 1998 (60+)
pr_nonmy_before_aug98_60_plus.note: Applicable for PR and Non-MY registered before 1 Aug 1998 only

included: Payment in respect of unutilised annual or medical leave
Paid maternity leave/Wages for maternity leaves
Paid study leave/Wages for study leaves
Other payments under services contract or otherwise
excluded: Payment in lieu of notice of termination of employment
Travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession

notes: Third Schedule PDF contains full wage range lookup tables
Wages above RM20,000 use percentage; up to RM20,000 use wage range table
